objective_for_doctor:
Age: 52
Sex: Male
Chief Complaint: I have right side of the chest pain, left side of the chest pain, and right posterior chest wall pain

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening:
I’m a 52-year-old man, and I came in because I have very bad chest pain—on the right side and also the left side—and pain in my right posterior chest wall. It feels like a sharp “knife-stroke” pain, it gets worse when I breathe (pleuritic), and I’ve also had significant shortness of breath.  

I also noticed swelling in my left calf, and I actually lost consciousness at some point. I have active cancer, I had surgery within the last month, and I’ve had recent travel to North America.
